newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDESPar to sell Copel shrs Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDESPar to sell Copel shrs Friday.

text.p: Brazil's BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment wing of the National Development Bank (BNDES), will auction 8.4 billion common shares of power utility Copel on Friday, a broker said.

The shares account for 3.5 percent of Copel's total capital and 5.8 percent of the firm's voting shares, said Eduardo Rangel, head of the Capital Markets department at investment bank Banco Pactual, one of the brokers of the deal.
Rangel said the shares will be sold for a minimum price of 10.51 reais per 1,000 shares or 88 million reais.
Copel is a power generator and distributor in the southern state of Parana.
The sale also will be coordinated by banks Banestado, Fonte Cindam, Bradesco, Citibank and Bozano, Simonsen.
The auction will take place on the Parana Stock Exchange.
